Daybound is an iPhone app for people who live under day limits: UK settlement (ILR) and citizenship
absence rules, Schengen 90/180, tax residence tests, US Substantial Presence. It records the country you
sleep in each night, automatically, and keeps everything in a Google Sheet that belongs to you.

## What it does

- **Tracks by itself.** With "Always" location access, iOS wakes the app when you move; the app keeps the
  country, time and a coarse position of each fix on the phone.
- **Writes one row per night** to your own Google Sheet: date, country, evidence. Nothing is sent anywhere else.
- **Counts days the way each law does.** Whole days only for UK continuous residence, any part of a day for
  Schengen and the US test, where you are at midnight for tax residence.
- **Projects your settlement date**: the earliest day you can apply for ILR given the 180-day rule, including a
  restart after a breach.
- **Keeps a full location log** in a second sheet you own, and imports your Google Maps Timeline export so the
  past is yours too.
- **Corrections are auditable.** The only manual action is "Correct this day", which needs a reason and writes
  it to the sheet's evidence column.

## Your data

There is no LocationTrack server and no account with us. Your data lives on your phone and in your Google
Drive. See the [privacy policy](privacy.qmd).
